cases.name: audit-capture --base: the diff is the batch's own, a file modified before the batch and left untouched stays out of the diff and the list
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/capture-{{SID}}; W=$R.jsonl; O=$R.out/audit.txt; rm -rf $R $W $R.out; mkdir -p $R/src $R/tests $R/.claude && cd $R && git init -q && printf '{"commands": {"build": "true", "architectureTest": {"run": "true", "when": "^$"}}}
' > .claude/kit.config.json && printf '# S
' > sheet.md && printf 'v0
' > src/Seed.cs && git add -A && git -c user.name=eval -c user.email=eval@example.invalid -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -qm init && printf 'early
' > src/Early.cs && cd {{ROOT}} && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/batch-baseline.py snapshot $W F1 --root $R >/dev/null && printf 'batch
' > $R/src/Batch.cs && cd $R && bash {{KIT}}/scripts/audit-capture.sh F1 sheet.md $O --base $W >/dev/null && echo "$(grep -c '^+early' $O)|$(grep -c '^+batch' $O)|$(grep -c '^src/Batch.cs$' $O)|$(grep -c '^src/Early.cs$' $O)"

cases.name: audit-capture: a diff past 1200 lines is never cut, it stays in its own file and the capture indexes it file by file
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/capture-{{SID}}; O=$R.out/audit.txt; rm -rf $R $R.out; mkdir -p $R/src $R/tests $R/.claude && cd $R && git init -q && printf '{"commands": {"build": "true", "architectureTest": {"run": "true", "when": "^$"}}}
' > .claude/kit.config.json && printf '# S
' > sheet.md && printf 'v0
' > src/Seed.cs && git add -A && git -c user.name=eval -c user.email=eval@example.invalid -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -qm init && seq 1 1300 > src/Big.cs && printf 'small
' > src/Small.cs && bash {{KIT}}/scripts/audit-capture.sh F1 sheet.md $O >/dev/null && echo "$(grep -c '^full diff: ' $O)|$(grep -c '^b/src/Big.cs: lines ' $O)|$(grep -c '^b/src/Small.cs: lines ' $O)|$(test -f $R.out/audit.diff && echo kept || echo removed)"

cases.name: audit-capture writes `## Mechanical audit`: a clean diff, a passing build and the suites given green are `ok`, an ArchitectureTests not triggered, a sheet without `## Cycles` and the layer rules are `not checked`
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/capture-{{SID}}; O=$R.out/audit.txt; rm -rf $R $R.out; mkdir -p $R/src $R/tests $R/.claude && cd $R && git init -q && printf '%s
' '{"commands": {"build": "true", "architectureTest": {"run": "true", "when": "^$"}}}' > .claude/kit.config.json && printf '# S
' > sheet.md && printf 'v0
' > src/Seed.cs && git add -A && git -c user.name=eval -c user.email=eval@example.invalid -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -qm init && printf 'batch
' > src/Batch.cs && bash {{KIT}}/scripts/audit-capture.sh F1 sheet.md $O --suites-green UnitTests >/dev/null && echo "$(grep -c '^=== Mechanical audit — F1 ===$' $O)|$(grep -c '^| Scope | `git diff --check` | ok | ' $O)|$(grep -c '^| Validations | build | ok | ' $O)|$(grep -c '^| Validations | ArchitectureTests | not checked | ' $O)|$(grep -c '^| Validations | suites green[^|]* | ok | ' $O)|$(grep -c '^| Layer rules | [^|]* | not checked | ' $O)|$(grep -c '^| TDD | every cycle[^|]* | not checked | ' $O)"

cases.name: audit-capture `## Mechanical audit`: trailing whitespace, a file outside the batch and absent from the sheet, a red build and a red ArchitectureTests are `gap`, no --suites-green is `not checked`
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/capture-{{SID}}; O=$R.out/audit.txt; rm -rf $R $R.out; mkdir -p $R/src $R/tests $R/.claude && cd $R && git init -q && printf '%s
' '{"commands": {"build": "false", "architectureTest": {"run": "false", "when": "src"}}}' > .claude/kit.config.json && printf '# S
' > sheet.md && printf 'v0
' > src/Seed.cs && git add -A && git -c user.name=eval -c user.email=eval@example.invalid -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -qm init && printf 'v1 
' > src/Seed.cs && printf 'z
' > stray.txt && bash {{KIT}}/scripts/audit-capture.sh F1 sheet.md $O >/dev/null && echo "$(grep -c '^| Scope | `git diff --check` | gap | ' $O)|$(grep -c '^| Scope | every modified file[^|]* | gap | ' $O)|$(grep -c '^| Validations | build | gap | ' $O)|$(grep -c '^| Validations | ArchitectureTests | gap | ' $O)|$(grep -c '^| Validations | suites green[^|]* | not checked | ' $O)"
